objectives.text: The role of the FHLBanks in providing secured advances must be distinguished from the Federal Reserve's financing facilities, which are set up to provide emergency financing for troubled financial institutions confronted with immediate liquidity challenges.

citations.quote: The role of the FHLBanks in providing secured advances must be distinguished from the Federal Reserve’s financing facilities, which are set up to provide emergency financing for troubled financial institutions confronted with immediate liquidity challenges.

objectives.text: The distinction between the FHLBank System's role and that of the Federal Reserve discount window as lender of last resort has not been clear, especially during times of market stress.

citations.quote: The FHLBanks remain a reliable source of liquidity for members, but the distinction between the System’s role and that of the Federal Reserve discount window as lender of last resort has not been clear, especially during times of market stress.

objectives.text: During the March 2023 bank failures, some large, troubled members had not established the ability to borrow from the Federal Reserve discount window and were therefore overly reliant on the FHLBanks.

citations.quote: During the March 2023 bank failures, the FHLBanks also discovered that some large, troubled members had not established the ability to borrow from the Federal Reserve discount window and therefore were overly reliant on the FHLBanks.

objectives.text: Reliance of some large, troubled members on the FHLBanks rather than the Federal Reserve during periods of significant financial stress may be inconsistent with the relative responsibilities of the two institutions.

citations.quote: The reliance of some large, troubled members on the FHLBanks, rather than the Federal Reserve, for liquidity during periods of significant financial stress may be inconsistent with the relative responsibilities of the FHLBanks and the Federal Reserve.

objectives.text: During the March 2023 events, FHLBank funding desks lacked clear lines of communication to the Federal Reserve's discount window.

citations.quote: During the March 2023 events, FHFA observed that the FHLBanks’ funding desks did not have clear lines of communication to the Federal Reserve’s discount window.

objectives.text: FHLBanks rely on supervisory information from a member's primary federal regulator, but that information may be lagged.

citations.quote: The FHLBanks rely on supervisory information from a primary federal regulator for a general perspective of a member’s financial health, but the information may be lagged.

objectives.text: FHLBanks generally obtain reports of examination from primary federal regulators only upon request, and consequently may receive them long after problems are identified.

citations.quote: FHLBanks generally obtain reports of examination from primary federal regulators only upon request, and consequently, FHLBanks may receive reports of examination long after problems are identified.

objectives.text: Examination reports are not directly available to FHFA, even though they are available to FHLBanks upon request.

citations.quote: However, the examination reports are not directly available to FHFA.

objectives.text: During the March 2023 events, some troubled members misunderstood the ability of an FHLBank to provide late-in-day advances, especially in large volumes, and an FHLBank's ability to make advances may be very limited once financial markets close.

citations.quote: During the March 2023 events, some troubled members misunderstood the ability of an FHLBank to provide advances late in a business day, especially in large volumes.
When financial markets close, an FHLBank’s ability to make advances to a member may be very limited.

objectives.text: A large debt issuance for a single FHLBank can distort advance pricing for all FHLBank members, highlighting the need to adjust processes to ensure reliable low-cost liquidity for all members.

citations.quote: This issuance highlighted the need to adjust current processes to ensure that FHLBanks can reliably provide liquidity at a low cost to all members, not just one large member.

objectives.text: The market disruptions in March 2023 exposed weaknesses in member credit evaluations by certain FHLBanks that impeded adequate anticipation and management of the risk of potential member failures.

citations.quote: The market disruptions in March 2023 exposed weaknesses in the member credit evaluations by certain FHLBanks that impeded adequate anticipation and management of the risk of potential member failures.

objectives.text: FHFA identified areas where supervisory assumptions based on previous experience were insufficient or inaccurate when applied to a highly stressed, rapidly developing scenario.

citations.quote: FHFA has identified areas where supervisory assumptions based on previous experience were insufficient or inaccurate when applied to a highly stressed, rapidly developing scenario.

obligations.action: work with their members' primary regulators to ensure processes are built to meet the needs of members in all market conditions

citations.quote: The FHLBanks must also work with their members’ primary regulators to ensure processes are built to meet the needs of members in all market conditions.

obligations.action: coordinate with their members' primary regulators and the regional Federal Reserve Banks to ensure financial institutions' borrowing needs continue to be met
obligations.trigger: when they no longer meet the FHLBanks' credit criteria

citations.quote: To address this, the FHLBanks should coordinate with their members’ primary regulators and the regional Federal Reserve Banks to ensure financial institutions’ borrowing needs continue to be met when they no longer meet the FHLBanks’ credit criteria.

obligations.action: coordinate with large depository institution members and the members' prudential regulators to make certain that these members have established protocols to meet emergency liquidity needs from the Federal Reserve discount window

citations.quote: The FHLBanks can better serve their members if they coordinate with their large depository institution members and the members’ prudential regulators to make certain that these members have established protocols to meet their emergency liquidity needs from the Federal Reserve discount window when necessary.

obligations.action: provide guidance to the FHLBanks to work with their members and the members' primary federal regulators to ensure all large depository members have established protocols to borrow from the Federal Reserve discount window
obligations.trigger: so that these institutions' borrowing needs continue to be met

citations.quote: Accordingly, FHFA will provide guidance to the FHLBanks to work with their members and the members’ primary federal regulators to ensure all large depository members have established protocols to borrow from the Federal Reserve discount window so that these institutions’ borrowing needs continue to be met.

obligations.action: negotiate appropriate agreements with the regional Federal Reserve Banks to ensure expedited movement of collateral
obligations.trigger: if a member's lending activity must be moved to the Federal Reserve discount window

citations.quote: Additionally, FHFA expects the FHLBanks to negotiate appropriate agreements with the regional Federal Reserve Banks to ensure expedited movement of collateral if a member’s lending activity must be moved to the Federal Reserve discount window.

obligations.action: undertake a rulemaking to amend its regulation establishing limits on unsecured extensions of credit to provide deposits held in IBDAs at highly-rated banks with the higher limit that currently applies only to overnight fed funds

citations.quote: FHFA plans to undertake a rulemaking to amend its regulation establishing limits on unsecured extensions of credit to provide deposits held in IBDAs at highly-rated banks with the higher limit that currently applies only to overnight fed funds.

obligations.action: revisit their policies, procedures, and systems for evaluating the financial condition of members
obligations.trigger: communicated FHFA expectation following weaknesses exposed by March 2023 disruptions

citations.quote: As a result, FHFA has communicated its expectation that the FHLBanks revisit their policies, procedures, and systems for evaluating the financial condition of members.

obligations.action: issue updated guidance related to ongoing evaluations of member credit, with the goal of FHLBanks working with members and primary regulators to identify concerns before they precipitate impairment of a member's ability to receive advances

citations.quote: In addition, FHFA will issue updated guidance related to ongoing evaluations of member credit with the goal of the FHLBanks working with their members and their members’ primary regulators to identify concerns before they precipitate impairment of a member’s ability to receive advances.

obligations.action: initiate a study of the FHLBank System's treatment of prepayment fees for certain situations

citations.quote: FHFA will initiate a study of the FHLBank System’s treatment of prepayment fees for certain situations.

obligations.action: consider initiating a rulemaking to amend the Advances regulation to make the FHLBank or the FHLBank System responsible for prepayment fees due from a failed member on long-term advances provided shortly before the member fails and without consultation with the primary federal regulator

citations.quote: As a result, FHFA may consider initiating a rulemaking to amend the Advances regulation to make the FHLBank or the FHLBank System responsible for prepayment fees due from a failed member on long-term advances provided shortly before the member fails and without consultation with the primary federal regulator.

obligations.action: initiate a rulemaking to require certain stress testing protocols for the FHLBanks

citations.quote: FHFA plans to initiate a rulemaking to require certain stress testing protocols for the FHLBanks.

obligations.action: propose adjusting the scenarios published by the Federal Reserve to reflect the risks present in the FHLBank System

citations.quote: FHFA will propose adjusting the scenarios published by the Federal Reserve, as warranted, to reflect the risks present in the FHLBank System, which may differ in some ways from the risks faced by financial institutions that are subject to stress testing under the Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act.

obligations.action: review the district realignment issue in the near term and establish a protocol for regular periodic reviews to determine whether districts should be re-aligned

citations.quote: FHFA will review the issue in the near term and establish a protocol for regular periodic reviews to determine whether districts should be re-aligned.

obligations.action: recommend statutory amendments to Congress
obligations.trigger: if it determines such changes are warranted, given the general authority for consolidation is limited by the requirement that the number of FHLBank districts not be reduced to fewer than eight
obligations.threshold: number of FHLBank districts not reduced to fewer than eight
exceptions: subject to the exceptions described above

citations.quote: However, because that general authority for consolidation is limited by the requirement that the number of FHLBank districts not be reduced to fewer than eight, subject to the exceptions described above, FHFA may recommend statutory amendments to Congress if it determines such changes are warranted.

obligations.action: continue to monitor the effect multi-district members have on the FHLBanks and encourage improved communication and information sharing among the FHLBanks on the borrowing activity of multi-district members

citations.quote: FHFA will continue to monitor the effect multi-district members have on the FHLBanks and encourages improved communication and information sharing among the FHLBanks on the borrowing activity of multi-district members.

obligations.action: provide guidance on multi-district member management

citations.quote: FHFA will provide guidance on multi-district member management as necessary.

obligations.action: recommend that Congress amend the Safety and Soundness Act to eliminate the restrictions on the Agency's authority to prescribe levels or ranges for the compensation of executive officers of the FHLBanks

citations.quote: FHFA plans to recommend that Congress amend the Safety and Soundness Act to eliminate the restrictions on the Agency’s authority to prescribe levels or ranges for the compensation of executive officers of the FHLBanks.

obligations.action: draft agreements with the Federal Reserve Banks that would facilitate the transfer of a member's collateral to the Federal Reserve if the member needs to borrow from the discount window
obligations.trigger: if the member needs to borrow from the discount window

citations.quote: As a result, the FHLBanks have already begun discussions with the Federal Reserve Banks to draft agreements that would facilitate the transfer of a member’s collateral to the Federal Reserve if the member needs to borrow from the discount window.

obligations.action: initiate discussions with members' primary federal regulators to improve the timely exchange of information on member financial condition

citations.quote: FHFA has also initiated discussions with members’ primary federal regulators to improve the timely exchange of information on member financial condition.

obligations.action: actively monitor the FHLBanks' lending activity and provide guidance to them to reassess and update their member credit frameworks

citations.quote: As a result, FHFA is actively monitoring the FHLBanks’ lending activity and has provided guidance to them to reassess and update their member credit frameworks.

obligations.action: provide guidance to the FHLBanks to improve communication with members regarding the FHLBanks' limitations on extending further credit when a member's distress signals potential failure

citations.quote: Additionally, FHFA has provided guidance to the FHLBanks to improve communication with members regarding the FHLBanks’ limitations on extending further credit when a member’s distress signals potential failure.

obligations.action: not rely primarily on collateral to mitigate risk in tenuous situations, capturing all appropriate dimensions of risk when assessing member creditworthiness

citations.quote: FHFA has also emphasized the importance of capturing all appropriate dimensions of risk when assessing member creditworthiness and that the FHLBanks should not rely primarily on collateral to mitigate risk in tenuous situations.

obligations.action: make those members' reports of examination available to the appropriate FHLBank

citations.quote: By statute, members’ primary federal regulators are required to make those members’ reports of examination available to the appropriate FHLBank upon request.

obligations.action: work with the FHLBanks to ensure they are preemptively establishing the necessary expectations and infrastructure to transition members from their FHLBank to the Federal Reserve discount window

citations.quote: FHFA is working with the FHLBanks to ensure they are preemptively establishing the necessary expectations and infrastructure to transition members from their FHLBank to the Federal Reserve discount window when necessary.

notes: Source contains internally coexisting modal framings for closely related duties: e.g., FHLBanks 'must' work with primary regulators generally (unconditional), but 'should' coordinate on discount-window transition specifically, and 'can better serve members if they coordinate' (conditional/aspirational) — preserved as written per fidelity rule, not harmonized into a single modality. Text does not define key scope terms (lender of last resort, discount window, advances, IBDAs, AHP, prepayment fees, multi-district members, reports of examination); these are recorded as material undefined terms. The text asserts a statutory duty on primary federal regulators to share exam reports with FHLBanks 'upon request' but simultaneously states such reports 'may be lagged' and arrive 'long after problems are identified' — an unresolved tension preserved as written. Scope note: extraction covers only the discount-window/FHLB interoperability, stigma-adjacent, and reporting-timing material within this source; the source does not itself catalogue discount-window stigma causes or Call Report/FR 2052a granularity issues, nor does it map Hsu/McKernan reform proposals — those elements of the ratified scope are not present in this particular source item.
